versions.content: The ECU Manager module shall invoke the EcuM_Generat- eRamHash (see [SWS_EcuM_02919] ) callout before halting the microcontroller the 49 of 210 Document ID 78: AUTOSAR_SWS_ECUStateManager Specification of ECU State Manager AUTOSAR CP R20-11 EcuM_CheckRamHash (see [SWS_EcuM_02921] ) callout after the processor returns from halt. In case of applied multi core and existence of "slave" EcuM(s) this check should be executed on the "master" EcuM only. The "master" EcuM generates the hash out of all data that lie within its reach. Private data of "slave" EcuMs are out of scope.
